clusters.headline: Regional Leaders Convene In Manila For The 49th ASEAN Summit Event
aiSummaryBullets: Heads of state from across Southeast Asia and global partners arrived in Manila for the 49th ASEAN Summit.
The agenda includes discussions on maritime security, regional trade, and an ongoing energy crisis.

clusters.headline: Philippines Wins The Inaugural Eurovision Song Contest Asia Title
aiSummaryBullets: The Philippines claimed victory at the inaugural Eurovision Song Contest Asia held in Bangkok.
Teenage performer Carmelle Collado won the title with a dance track dedicated to Filipino women.

clusters.headline: Thomas Markle Jr Identified As Person Of Interest In Abuse Inquiry
aiSummaryBullets: Thomas Markle Jr has been linked to a child sexual abuse inquiry.
Authorities have officially named him a person of interest.
